discovery.summary: Check whether a domain expires within a future horizon
discovery.description: Resolve a domain via IANA RDAP bootstrap and its authoritative registry, then compare the published expiration date with a caller-selected future horizon. Returns expiring_soon, not_expiring_soon, unregistered, or human_review. Registry grace/renewal policies vary; this is a registration timing signal and not proof of ownership, control, legitimacy, security, fraud risk, or business identity.
discovery.resource_description: Determine whether an authoritative RDAP domain expiration date falls within a caller-selected future horizon. Returns expiring_soon, not_expiring_soon, unregistered, or human_review. This is a registration timing signal only and does not prove ownership, control, legitimacy, security, fraud risk, or business identity.

buyer.task: Determine whether an authoritative RDAP domain expiration date falls within a caller-selected future horizon.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independent settled purchases and repeat buyers per product after launch; do not infer demand from tests or crawler probes.

sources.authority: IANA DNS bootstrap plus authoritative registry RDAP
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative domain lookup on each paid request
sources.cache_policy: IANA bootstrap cached in memory for adapter lifetime; authoritative domain result not cached

rules: Resolve the domain through IANA bootstrap and authoritative registry RDAP.
Return unregistered when authoritative RDAP reports the domain is not registered.
Require a usable authoritative expiration/expiry event date.
Return expiring_soon when expiration is on or before the future horizon cutoff; return not_expiring_soon when later; otherwise return human_review.

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; caller should retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Release gate passes from the same registry revision.
Authoritative live-source smoke passes without source failures.
Shared non-credit-gated hosting is available and measured.
Post-allowance unit economics are settlement-negative at the current price; commercial promotion remains blocked until economics are repaired or an explicit exception is approved.
